gloss: to be attentive to others' needs; to be considerate

definitions.gloss: to be attentive; to notice what others need; to be considerate
definitions.explanation: To have one's attention reach the small things other people need before being asked. Literally 'one's attention goes around.' Usually a compliment, most often in the negative — {気|き}が{回|まわ}らなかった means 'it didn't occur to me.'

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧{気|き}が{回|まわ}る。
⟦そこ→そこ：00991_soko⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{回|まわ}らなかった→回る：01150_mawaru⟧。
examples.english: It didn't occur to me to go that far.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新人|しんじん}→新人：02500_shinjin⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧⟦ところ→所：01137_tokoro⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{気|き}が{回|まわ}る⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
examples.english: Even though he's new, he's the sort who notices the smallest things.

examples.japanese: ⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追|お}われて→追う：02016_ou⟧、{お客|きゃく}さん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{飲|の}み{物|もの}→飲み物：02929_nomimono⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{回|まわ}らなかった→回る：01150_mawaru⟧。
examples.english: I was so busy with the preparations that I didn't think as far as drinks for the guests.

notes:
STRUCTURE: ⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧ (attention) + ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ + ⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧ (to go around).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧{気|き}が{回|まわ}る: to be very attentive (standard praise)
- ⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{回|まわ}らない→回る：01150_mawaru⟧: to fail to notice, to not think of
- ⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧⟦ところ→所：01137_tokoro⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{気|き}が{回|まわ}る: to notice even small details

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{気|き}が{利|き}く→気が利く：06880_kigakiku⟧: to be thoughtful — nearly synonymous; ⟦{気|き}が{利|き}く→気が利く：06880_kigakiku⟧ also describes objects and gifts as 'clever, well-chosen', which {気|き}が{回|まわ}る does not
- ⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to be considerate — an effort the speaker consciously makes, often tiring; {気|き}が{回|まわ}る happens naturally
